name: Theme Manager
description: Seasonal and permanent themes, a personal theme per user, library banners and theme packs for Jellyfin Web.
overview: Each user chooses their own theme; server branding is not changed. Install File Transformation to show themes in the normal Jellyfin Web address.

versions.changelog: Thumbnails in the theme picker; holidays can be left out of Automatic Seasonal (Danish-only holidays off outside Denmark); new installs use the server's own time zone.
Thumbnails in the theme picker; holidays can be left out of Automatic Seasonal (Danish-only holidays off outside Denmark); new installs use the server's own time zone.
Thumbnails in the theme picker; holidays can be left out of Automatic Seasonal (Danish-only holidays off outside Denmark); new installs use the server's own time zone.
Fix: browsers that had Jellyfin Web cached from before File Transformation was installed now get the theme after a normal reload.
Build for Jellyfin 12.1.0 of 0.2.3.0. Same code as the 12.2 build; not yet tested on a 12.1.0 server.
Build for Jellyfin 12.0.0 of 0.2.3.0. Same code as the 12.2 build; not yet tested on a 12.0.0 server.
Updated texts: the admin page and plugin description no longer call the plugin an alpha that leaves the home screen unchanged.
Ships the 29 standard themes (19 calendar themes with artwork, 10 colour themes). They are installed on first start; existing and deleted packs are left alone.
First public preview: personal themes, seasonal calendar, custom calendars, library banners for every library, File Transformation support.
